\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Position $q_t$ in straddles, from the gap $s_t = \hat\sigma^2_t - (IV^{30}_t)^2$ and the
earlier days only: $\sign(s)$, $q_t = \pm 1$; Clip (robust clip), $q_t = \clip(s_t/m_t, -1, 1)$ with $m_t$ the median
$|s_u|$ over $u < t$; Long/scaled (full long, scaled short), $q_t = 1$ if $s_t > 0$, else $\max(s_t/m_t, -1)$; Rank
$|s|$, $q_t = \sign(s_t)$ times the share of earlier days with $|s_u| \le |s_t|$. The first 252 days only build the
scale, so every rule, $\sign(s)$ included, is scored on the last 614 of the 866 days. Crossed: the spread is paid
on $|q_t|$ straddles. Model-set rows: the median over the 112 forecasts of the model set (the MinGRU is not in it), and
the number of them whose Sharpe ratio is above their own $\sign(s)$ Sharpe ratio. Point estimates; no test.
Sharpe ratio $=\sqrt{252}\,\bar r/\mathrm{sd}(r)$, annualised per trade day (the trade runs about 200 days a year).
\end{tablenotes}
